articles.summary: Nobody hands independent artists a manual. How do you book a tour, read a contract, make a great music video, or know when you’re ready for a manager? Many artists figure it out alone. In September, Spotify launched Fresh Finds Forward, a program giving approximately 10,000 emerging independent artists each year resources, community, and support...
articles.title: Spotify to Gather Emerging Artists for First Fresh Finds Summit, With Sessions From John Legend, Ryan Tedder, María Zardoya, and More

articles.summary: On Sunday, Spotify teamed up with Live Nation Urban for RNB X Live, our first-ever standalone R&B festival. The event brought Spotify’s flagship R&B playlist RNB X to life at The Pavilion at Toyota Music Factory in Dallas, celebrating the genre’s legacy alongside the next generation of artists shaping it.
